name: 98365 · Port Ludlow, WA
findings: ZIP 98365 (Port Ludlow) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98365 (Port Ludlow) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
